title: Padikkal or Sudharsan? Manjrekar makes No. 3 call: 'He looks formidable'

title: OpenAI's S7 data centre drops plan to cool it with recycled water after permit snags

title: 'Go after terrorists wherever they are': Doval reveals PM Modi’s brief on Op Sindoor
content: ajit Doval offers a rare glimpse into the strategic thinking behind Op Sindoor . he detailed how India set its objectives for the 88-hour military operation launched in response to the Pahalgam terror attack . the national security adviser says he will not forgive the perpetrators .
